svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut a 212 x 122 mm blank from 1.5 mm polycarbonate; keep the film on.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut a 10 x 10 mm notch at each corner (clears the lid screw pillars).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut four cable tie slots, 2.5 x 6 mm: two open notches on the left edge

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and two slots 113.5 to 116 mm from the left edge; all four centred

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 19 and 57 mm from the front edge.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill the 21 holes 3.4 mm at the positions on the plate hole layout:

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: five for the standoffs, the rest for the parts on the plate.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Score and snap or saw with a fine blade; file the edges smooth.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the plate sits on five 5 mm standoffs, 1 mm in from every wall.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Every part is screwed to the plate before it goes into the case.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: lay it in the case; it drops in flat past the corner pillars.
